LBY.note: The document names a digital skills assessment platform but not training of civil servants.
The national data distributor is described by its role in integration, not as live or carrying data.
The skills assessment platform is named only, with no training, count or survey share stated.
Only the national data distributor's integration role is mentioned; no framework, draft or adoption is stated.
No open data policy is stated; the portal alone places nothing.

facts.fact: The General Information Authority presented its open data platform, which holds 166 datasets, at the Libyan Permanent Economic Forum in Tripoli, as reported by LANA.

LBY.note: Nothing about shared regional infrastructure is stated.
